checks.detail: tests.test_control_plane_campaign_adapters runs 30 tests and tests.test_control_plane_campaign runs 140 tests with 0 failures on the locked runtime; the new suite covers normalization statuses, malformed tokens/costs, model identifier rejection, flag preservation, adapter call counting, retry-ownership fail-closed, and retry exhaustion.

The T3 diff is limited to two new files (438-line adapter module and 426-line test module); no existing production module, test, or dependency changed; no dead code, no SDK import, no network or subprocess usage.

Usage normalization bounds integer tokens to 512 bits, cost text to 128 characters, and currency/text to 256 characters; non-finite floats/Decimals are rejected; model identifiers use the control-plane identifier regex; no unbounded parsing, eval, exec, or external I/O.

The integration test proves RetryingModelInvocation owns retries: one transient handler failure followed by success yields adapter.calls==2, two begin envelopes (EXCEPTION then RESPONSE_RECEIVED), and one SUCCESS finish; retry exhaustion yields exactly max_attempts adapter calls and raises ModelInvocationProviderError.
Spec and quality reviewer actor ids are distinct from the task actor and from each other; invocation ids are recorded; external usage is declared UNKNOWN.

advisories.detail: Float costs are normalized with repr() rather than str(); for standard finite floats the decimal text is identical (for example 0.5), and Decimal parsing accepts exponent notation, so no observable difference exists for supported values.
